name: validate_skill
description: Statically validate a skill definition without saving anything. Pass the exact arguments you intend to give save_skill; returns valid plus warnings, or an error listing every problem. Static check only — filesystem conflicts (an existing file or package at the target, `overwrite=false`) are reported by `save_skill` itself.

description.description: Short summary shown in skill lists and matching.

prompt.description: Full skill prompt body (Markdown) to validate.

tools.description: Explicit tool names that the skill is allowed to use.

tool_groups.description: Tool groups that the skill is allowed to use (e.g. builtin, executor).

mcp_servers.description: Required MCP server names needed to run this skill.

resources.description: Optional bundled resources, each with relative `path` and `content`.

subskills.description: Optional nested sub-skills, each with `name` and `prompt`.
